name: hello-file
goal: Substrate self-test: verify the eval harness loads a case, copies a setup file into the workspace, and the deterministic checks correctly identify the expected content.

notes.purpose: Post-Phase-4 substrate smoke test. The pre-prune semantics — "can the architect produce hello.txt?" — are gone with the architect (Phase 4 §3). This case now validates the substrate (case loader + workspace setup + deterministic checks + JSONL persistence). A FAIL here means the harness itself is broken, not any producer.
